Nuked OPL3 emulates the AdLib-compatible OPL2 sound path.
Copyright (C) 2013-2020 Nuke.YKT, LGPL-2.1-or-later.
https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3
Pinned source: 765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8
See Nuked-OPL3-LGPL-2.1.txt. CMake obtains the complete source and builds it locally.

miniaudio supplies native PCM output. Copyright David Reid and contributors.
Public domain or MIT No Attribution; see miniaudio-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio
Pinned source: f40cf03f80cdb7e741d43e53b7e706e8c1394bcf

Original register patches and gameplay sound design are by Corncob's authors.

The pinned miniaudio source also supplies Sean Barrett's stb_vorbis decoder
(v1.22), used for the embedded Ogg music. It is built locally with file I/O
and the push-data API disabled. Public domain or MIT; see stb-vorbis-LICENSE.txt.
Original music is by James L. Collymore and retains its original copyright.
